78: def evaluate(report, exit_code, expected_count, fault_title=None):
79:     files=report.get('testResults', [])
80:     assertions=[a for f in files for a in f.get('assertionResults', [])]
81:     titles={a.get('title') for a in assertions}
82:     counts={k:sum(a.get('status')==k for a in assertions) for k in ['passed','failed','pending','skipped','todo']}
83:     collected=(len(assertions)==expected_count and report.get('numTotalTests')==expected_count and EXPECTED<=titles
84:                and bool(files) and all(f.get('assertionResults') for f in files))
85:     completed=(len(assertions)>0 and counts['passed']+counts['failed']==len(assertions)
86:                and report.get('numPassedTests')==counts['passed'] and report.get('numFailedTests')==counts['failed']
87:                and report.get('numPendingTests')==0)
88:     failures=[{'title':a.get('title'),'messages':a.get('failureMessages',[])} for a in assertions if a.get('status')=='failed']
89:     intended=(exit_code==1 and any(a['title']==fault_title and any('AssertionError:' in m for m in a['messages']) for a in failures))
90:     clean=exit_code==0 and report.get('success') is True and counts['failed']==0 and all(f.get('status')=='passed' for f in files)
91:     return {'expectation_met':bool(collected and completed and (intended if fault_title else clean)),
92:             'collected':collected,'completed':completed,'counts':counts,'required_titles_discovered':EXPECTED<=titles,
93:             'intended_fault_detected':intended,'clean_tests_passed':clean,'failing_assertions':failures,
94:             'file_load_errors':[{'name':f.get('name'),'message':f.get('message')} for f in files if not f.get('assertionResults')]}
